subject: Proposed South Street Historic District
overview: The Medford Historic District Commission reviewed outreach materials for a proposed historic district but was unable to vote on pending meeting minutes due to the lack of a quorum.

items.title: South Street Historic District Public Hearing Notice
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed and refined a draft letter inviting neighborhood property owners to an October 12 public hearing regarding the proposed South Street Historic District.

items.title: Quorum and Commission Administration
items.summary: Lacking a quorum to formally approve outstanding meeting minutes, members planned a brief follow-up meeting and discussed obtaining city administrative assistance for minute-taking.
